scope.unit: one story + one pre-registered scene group + one comparable A/B image pair
scope.storyboard_binding: bind every group to the selected storyboard artifact and source evidence before review
scope.image_generation: not performed by this contract tool; paid generation remains approval/grant gated

treatments.comparison_rule: same source, same storyboard binding, same scene-group scope, same review package
treatments.excluded_pairs: incomplete or non-comparable pairs are excluded and listed; they are never counted as failures or wins

catalog.label: 多人关系
catalog.requirement: 至少一个组必须同时呈现两名或以上可区分人物及其空间关系。

catalog.label: 重名与身份
catalog.requirement: 至少一个组必须能核对重名角色的身份、数量和指代，不能靠名字猜测。

catalog.label: 服装连续性
catalog.requirement: 跨相邻镜头核对服装、发型和可见状态；变化必须有来源依据。

catalog.label: 关键道具
catalog.requirement: 核对道具身份、数量、状态、空间位置和必要的相对尺度。

catalog.label: 昼夜变化
catalog.requirement: 跨场景或相邻镜头核对昼夜、光线和时间状态，不允许无来源跳变。

catalog.label: 动作连续性
catalog.requirement: 核对动作发生顺序、前后状态和因果关系，尤其是关键动作。

catalog.label: 复杂构图
catalog.requirement: 覆盖前后景、遮挡、多人站位或多个关键物体的可制作构图。

catalog.label: 单人基线
catalog.requirement: 提供低复杂度基线，用来区分复杂场景收益与基本生成稳定性。

catalog.label: 无对白动作
catalog.requirement: 不依赖对白，单独核对视觉动作和情绪表达。

catalog.label: 文字边界
catalog.requirement: 精确文字有要求时核对可读性；无要求时不得把乱码当作来源事实。

catalog.label: 旧路径兼容
catalog.requirement: 至少一组来自旧 storyboard 输入，核对旧格式映射和可比较产物。

catalog.label: 不可验证门
catalog.requirement: 至少一组保留证据不足时进入人工门的路径，不用规则检查冒充审美通过。

blind_ab.private_mapping: store separately from the reviewer package; never distribute to reviewers
blind_ab.randomization: derive the formal seed from the frozen sample fingerprint and balance A/B within stories

scoring.group_winner: strict majority of the three preference votes; otherwise tie
scoring.missing_or_invalid_row: the visual gate is not ready; do not impute a score

severe_errors.definition: a visible error that changes source meaning/identity/time/space or makes the image unusable for the declared shot
severe_errors.majority_rule: at least 2 of 3 reviewers mark the same side severe in a group
severe_errors.review_requirement: a severe mark requires at least one code and a concrete note; no generic pass/fail text

budget.per_story_generation_budget: freeze before any real run; use the project Grant and never infer a price here
budget.retry_policy: no automatic paid retry for unknown outcomes; local packaging never retries a provider

visual_gate.preference_statistics: story-clustered one-sided 95% lower bound must meet the threshold
visual_gate.source_fidelity: story-clustered one-sided 95% lower bound of agent-minus-legacy must be >= 0
visual_gate.character_consistency: story-clustered one-sided 95% lower bound of agent-minus-legacy must be >= 0
visual_gate.severe_error_count: agent majority-group count must be <= legacy majority-group count
visual_gate.coverage: all required coverage codes must be represented in the frozen sample manifest

release_gates.engineering: all visual/M2/ProductionRun structure, approval, authorization, budget, recovery and no-duplicate tests pass
release_gates.human_visual: three independent blind reviewers complete every comparable pair; no automated rule result substitutes for this gate
release_gates.real_execution: any real image generation requires user approval, isolated account, allowed profile, small Grant and operator evidence
release_gates.red_team: three independent reviews close all high-priority findings
release_gates.platform: Windows/Linux full regression passes on a clean commit
release_gates.default_route: do not change the legacy default until every gate is evidenced

safety.provider_calls: never from this module or its freeze/aggregate commands
safety.secret_handling: formal verification reads only the external ProductionRun HMAC key; never persist or print it or Provider credentials
safety.authority: ProductionRun HMAC events, final m8_visual_evidence_attested witness, VisualStageAdapter receipts and approved grants remain authoritative
safety.result_status: aggregation may report visual_gate_passed/failed, never formal release without external evidence
